# Ṣàngó, translated into industries: what the archetype actually does
Every age hires the same gods; only the job titles change. **Ṣàngó** never stopped working.

Ṣàngó's mythology moves between the palace and the sky. He is a king who could not govern his own household, a husband of multiple orishas, and a storm whose justice is as dramatic as its noise.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **5 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Ṣàngó
- **Pantheon:** Yoruba
- **Domain of influence:** Thunder, Fire, Justice
- **Pattern seats:** 5
- **Sectors touched:** Energy & Natural World · Society & Spirit · Commerce & Governance
- **Strongest seat:** Meteorology & Weather Intelligence
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 220 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Fourth King of Oyo.** Ṣàngó was the fourth Aláàfin (king) of Oyo.  The traditions disagree about his end: some say he hanged himself after a political defeat, others that he was consumed by his own fire and ascended to heaven. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.

**Ṣàngó and his Wives.** Ṣàngó is linked to several powerful female orishas.  Ọya is said to have been his favourite companion in war, learning the secrets of fire from him. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Meteorology & Weather Intelligence

*Forecasting, storm tracking, and climate analytics. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*The deified king who became the storm itself — “he who strikes”; thunder is his name and his judgment.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Ṣàngó performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations

*Religious institutions, faith media, and devotional services. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*The deified king at the heart of Santería and Candomblé.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Leadership, Governance & Public Administration

*Government, executive leadership, and statecraft. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The deified king of Oyo; thunder with a crown.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Legal, Justice & Compliance

*Law, courts, and regulatory compliance. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

*Thunder justice; the king who judges with fire.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Ṣàngó performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Thermal, Geothermal & Fire Energy

*Geothermal plants, combustion, and industrial heat. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Fire and thunder together; the strike that ignites.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Ṣàngó's mythology moves between the palace and the sky. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in meteorology & weather intelligence, faith & spiritual organizations, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/shango/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
